human.question: Which pricing case should the first cash forecast use?

brief.title: cash planning decision
brief.context: I’m building this week’s 13-week cash forecast. It will show whether the current operating plan preserves runway or whether we need to adjust spending or prepare a financing decision.
brief.decision: Which pricing case should the first forecast use?
brief.recommendation: Use Base as the working case unless you see a clear reason to plan defensively now. It gives us a credible operating view without assuming upside.
brief.reply: Reply `Base`, `Downside`, `Upside`, or your own case with one sentence of context.
brief.outcome: I’ll build the forecast, flag the runway and funding decision points, and bring it back for review.

brief.title: operating priority
brief.context: I’m preparing next week’s operating brief. We need one risk to focus the team on—the one most likely to disrupt the delivery plan or cash position if it is not addressed early.
brief.decision: Which risk should be the team’s priority this week?

brief.reply: Reply with the risk and one sentence on why it is the priority.
brief.outcome: I’ll prepare the brief with the owner, early-warning signs, and the first mitigation actions for review.
